recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-29119; a future rendered-link refinement would be editorial rather than required to satisfy this Published issue.
issue_request: FHIR-29119 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request for R5. It reported that not-subsumed was incorrectly defined as A and B being disjoint, which was too strong because not-subsumed should cover the exhaustive case where neither code subsumes the other; the approved resolution also updated all four CodeSystem concept definitions and added CodeSystem-level subsumption context.
initial_application: Jess Bota applied the issue in cb515c0480 by updating source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-subsumption-outcome.xml to add the CodeSystem description/title and replace all four concept definitions, including not-subsumed as "Neither A subsumes B nor B subsumes A". Follow-up commit c8876b14ca replaced the attempted markdown relative link with the accepted wording "under Resource Types - CodeSystem".
additional_context: Current source still has the approved FHIR-29119 definitions. The terminology service narrative describes not-subsumed as concepts not related by any subsumption relationship, and CodeSystem/$subsumes binds outcome to the concept-subsumption-outcome ValueSet. source/fhir.ini has active CodeSystem, ValueSet, and OperationDefinition entries, so the inspected source is in build scope. FHIR-34183 is already represented on the combined branch as a separate no-change audit for an earlier missing-ValueSet issue in the same terminology family.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The rejected disjoint wording is absent from the current CodeSystem definition, the other approved definitions remain present, and the non-link description wording was explicitly accepted in Jira comments and Vocabulary minutes.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue in the same concept-subsumption-outcome family reported the ValueSet missing from R4B; it is already represented on the combined branch and is separate from the FHIR-29119 definition correction.
